newsitem.title: FINLAND: MERITA UNITS SETS 3-YR AND 5-YR BONDS.
newsitem.headline: MERITA UNITS SETS 3-YR AND 5-YR BONDS.

text.p: Suomen Teollisuuspankki Oy, part of Merita Oy, will launch on April 7 two fixed-coupon bonds, one a 150 million markka 3.75 pct three-year bond and the other a 200 million markka 4.75 pct five-year bond, Merita said in a statement on Wednesday.
The issue prices will be variable. Annual interest will be paid on April 7, and the principal will be repaid in full on April 7, 2000, and on April 7, 2002 respectively.
The subscription period runs from April 7 to June 19 after which listings will be sought for the bonds on the Helsinki bourse, Merita said.
